title: Resources cache does not care of external change on file
body:
### Tested versions

Detected in 4.5 but still present in 4.6

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-5820K CPU @ 3.30GHz (12 threads) - 31.89 GiB memory

### Issue description

When you change subresources from outside of editor when closed in editor (mainly by switching VCS branch, but problem is present too if you just edit file with external editor like VIM or whatever text editor), change is not detected and when you open subresource file in editor old values are shown ; thus saving (with or without editing) overwrite external changes.

It seems the problem occurs when there is a default value in resource (an empty array, or a default int value, even not 0) on one state or the other (in cache and in file), but not so if values are not at default in both states.

The parent scene of changed subscene manifests same update problem if already open when change in subscene occurs : value in not updated in the editor, event with not default value this time.

Cache is cleared and no synchronization problem is visible when editor is closed/open or project reloaded.

It is a tricky problem that is not obvious at first sight and seems to be random, but in fact easy to reproduce.

I did not tested other kind of nodes than custom resources ones.

May be related to  https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/30302 (or not ?)

### Steps to reproduce

Make a main scene, with a sub scene that is made of a custom resource embedding other custom sub resource in say an array and so on ; each custom sub resource should have some exported properties with any default values.
Change sub resources values in editor in order to find them easily in external editor.
Then close sub scene ; keep main scene open.
Remove properties values in sub scene resources from outside (thus should be default one in editor after saving).
Look in editor ; main scene shows sub scene properties are not default ones.
Open sub scene : all resources properties are not default ones.

Same can be observed in other way (default values become not default, by using VCS branch switch or by forging manually which is a little harder than other way).

A typical MRP is provided for instance to play with.





### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[resources-cache-bug-with-vcs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24983689/resources-cache-bug-with-vcs.zip)
